components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action in the light workspace.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #155e75; color: #fff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #164e63; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #083344; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(34 211 238 / 0.55); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action; leans toward the accent only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #334155; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #a5f3fc; background: #f8fafc; color: #155e75; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(34 211 238 / 0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #fecdd3; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #be123c; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fff1f2; color: #9f1239; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(34 211 238 / 0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field; cyan focus halo, muted-floor placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0e7490; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cffafe; }

components.name: Panel / Card
components.description: The working surface — flat with soft shadow and signature white ring.
components.html:
服务单概览

28 天服务窗口，第 7 天。

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Active navigation on the dark shell — the loudest, rarest accent use.
components.html: 审核控制台数据看板
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; background: #020617; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #cbd5e1; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #22d3ee; color: #020617; } .ds-nav-item--active:hover { background: #22d3ee; color: #020617; }

components.description: State marker; color pair maps to health/risk/neutral.

narrative.overview: This is an internal operations console, not a product for sale. A dark navigation shell (near-black slate-950 sidebar and mobile header, lit by cyan accents) frames a light, evidence-dense workspace (cool slate-100 canvas, white panels). The dark chrome anchors the operator; the light workspace holds the work. The personality is professional, restrained, operationally precise — quiet, durable, trustworthy. Density is a virtue: desktop views stay information-rich while priority, state, and next action stay obvious. Type is a single sans in heavy weights; color is spent almost entirely on status and focus, never decoration. Mobile is a first-class operations path — every table has a stacked card fallback. This system explicitly rejects marketing-page composition: no oversized heroes, no decorative gradients, no glassmorphism, no playful illustrations, no inflated spacing, no nested cards.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navigation shell + light evidence workspace (deliberate two-layer neutral system).
Single accent (Teal Current) reserved for primary action, current selection, and state.
One sans family, heavy weights (900 / 700), fixed rem scale — never fluid clamp.
Flat-by-default surfaces: soft shadow-sm plus a signature white inner ring.
Density with hierarchy; mobile stacks to cards, never horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: Navigation is dark, work is light. Never invert it — no light sidebar, no dark content panels. The contrast between shell and workspace is how the operator stays oriented.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal/cyan appears on ≤10% of any workspace screen and only ever means action, current selection, or live state. The moment it decorates a heading or a divider, it stops being a signal.

rules.name: The Muted-Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text never drops below Ink Muted (#475569) on white; placeholder text uses the same value, not a lighter gray. Elegance is not worth failing 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Product type is a fixed rem scale, never clamp(). A heading that shrinks inside a sidebar looks broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: All hierarchy is weight + size within one family. Never introduce a display or serif face for flavor in labels, buttons, or data.

rules.name: The Flat-Ring Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest — shadow-sm + white ring, nothing heavier. Stronger emphasis comes from state (hover border shift, focus outline, highlight pulse), never from stacking bigger shadows.

dos: Do keep navigation dark (slate-950 + cyan accents) and the workspace light (slate-100 + white panels) — the Two-Layer Rule is the identity.
Do spend Teal Current / Signal Cyan only on primary action, current selection, and live state (≤10% of a screen).
Do use one sans family with weight + size for all hierarchy; fixed rem scale, never clamp().
Do keep body and placeholder text at Ink Muted (#475569) or darker on white — hit ≥4.5:1.
Do give every table a stacked mobile card fallback; wrap, stack, stay tappable (~44px) at 375px.
Do rest surfaces flat with shadow-sm + ring-1 ring-white; express emphasis through state, not bigger shadows.
Do keep every interactive component's full state set (hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading) — never ship half.
donts: Don't import marketing-page composition — no oversized hero sections, no decorative gradients, no inflated spacing.
Don't use glassmorphism (blur/glass cards) or playful illustrations; this is an operations console.
Don't nest cards inside cards, or place a dark panel inside the light workspace.
Don't use color or full-saturation accents on inactive/disabled states, or as decoration on headings and dividers.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe — use full borders, background tints, or leading icons.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) — emphasis comes from weight and size.
Don't introduce a display or serif face for UI labels, buttons, or data.
Don't let a mobile layout depend on desktop table widths or cause horizontal overflow.
Don't change API calls, data contracts, or the questionnaire shell isolation in the name of visual polish.
